{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Eye}}
{{Quote|Direct action is not always the best way; it is a far greater victory to make another see through your eyes than to close theirs forever.|[[Kreia]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Eye.png|thumb|right|200px|thumb|An eye detached from the body]]
The '''eye''' was the a visual organ of biological lifeforms. The outer coat enclosing the eyeball was referred to as the sclera.<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Most sentient species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] fared with a set of two eyes, most notably [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. There were some exceptions to this. Three-eyed species included the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Kobok/Legends|Kobok]],<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> and the [[Ubuugan]].<ref name="BFS">[[Boba Fett ½|''Boba Fett'' ½]]</ref> Four-eyed species including the [[Emente/Legends|Emente]],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Hysalrian/Legends|Hysalrians]],<ref name="SWG9">[[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]]</ref> the Ualaq subspecies of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]],<ref name="JQC">[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (comic series)|''Jedi Quest'' comic]]</ref> [[Annoo-dat Prime]],<ref name="JF">[[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']]</ref> [[Nalrithian]]s,<ref name="SWG5">[[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]]</ref> and another [[Unidentified four-eyed species|four-eyed species]].<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> Six-eyed species included the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]].<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Non-sentient species included the four-eyed [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Thrawn-SOC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chiss had piercing red eyes]]
There were many variations, from the subtly degraded night-vision of the local [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]],<ref name="Cracken's Threat Dossier">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> through the night-vision enhancing glowing red eyes of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]],<ref name="DF:SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> to the multi-faceted eyes of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and the exotic visual perceptions of the spacegoing [[Oswaft]].<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>

There were also species like the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]], who lost their eyes in the course of their evolution, depending instead on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="UAA" /> and the [[Shaper caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species, who had bred several species of highly sophisticated creatures called [[mqaaq'it]] to serve as symbiotic artificial eyes.<ref name="Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> Yuuzhan Vong had [[eye sack]]s under their eyes.

[[File:Vader_yelloweyes.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] eyes turned yellow by his immersion in the dark side.]]
The photosensitive cilia on the [[Cloak of Nuun]], another Yuuzhan Vong biot, were perhaps among the most exotic organic eyes known. Tiny membranes covering the creature's entire surface, they saw the immediate area with near-perfect accuracy from every angle, enabling the cloaker to disguise itself, chameleon-like, against its surroundings.<ref name="Emissary of the Void">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref>

The eyes of some [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] changed from their original colors to shades of fiery red-rimmed yellow, orange or red when they were deeply immersed in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> However, sometimes a darksider's natural eye color would remain or return.<ref name="Episode III" /><ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>
